svg.title: Validation loss by training step
svg.desc: Validation post-net log-mel MSE for each of 5 seeds. Dots: checkpoint kept for the steps budget. Source: runs/final_*/result.json, commit af156b3.
svg.text: Validation mel loss (lower is better), one line per seed, 5 seeds per optimizer. Dots mark the
checkpoint kept within the 400-step budget. All five optimizers start from the same pretrained model.
